summary: Mergeable PR that fixes a long-standing issue with limit_choices_to on ForeignKey fields.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new import from django.db.models, which may not be necessary and could be moved to the top of the file.
The use of Exists() to avoid duplicates may be overkill and could be simplified or optimized.
The patch could benefit from a docstring explaining the purpose of the apply_limit_choices_to_to_formfield function and its new behavior.
